definitions.title: Definitions of Hyperbolic Sine and Cosine
definitions.statement: Hyperbolic functions are symmetric combinations of exponential functions satisfying the fundamental hyperbolic identity cosh^2(x) - sinh^2(x) = 1.
definitions.explanation: Parameterize the unit hyperbola x^2 - y^2 = 1 in the same way circular trigonometric functions parameterize x^2 + y^2 = 1.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Hyperbolic functions model hanging cables (catenaries) and wave transmission.
